name: Cam Vinh
summary: Cam Vinh, also cam Xã Đoài, is the local orange. A cut fruit is gently sweet and fragrant, and a scuffed skin gives off a smell of its own.
origin: The national page and the city introduction say cam Vinh. The eight-specialty article places the orchard in Nghi Diên, Nghi Lộc. Both stay.
taste: The city portal’s eight-specialty article says a cut fruit is gently sweet and fragrant, and that a scuffed skin gives off a smell of its own.
howToEat: Eat it as the fruit. The eight-specialty article says a new-ripe fruit is yellow, then darker, still fresh-looking, with a thin skin that smells when it is scuffed, and that a cut fruit is gently sweet and fragrant. A drink recipe was not on these pages.
where: Buy it in the city. An orchard street in Vinh was not named. The eight-specialty article places the trees in Nghi Diên, Nghi Lộc. A shop is not named. A price is Check on arrival.
